args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and the FIN-212
spec (and tests/test_money.py) require banker's rounding. Change the
rounding mode so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66 as expected.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: changed the decimal rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match FIN-212.

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (includes `tests/test_money.py`, which checks `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`).

2. **Created branch** `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` from main and committed the one-line fix (plus import update) in `src/money.py`.
